topic: Day 19 — carousel — How you're treated when it's inconvenient is the real answer

slides.text: How someone treats you for free tells you little.
How they treat you when it costs them tells everything.
Low-cost kindness is common. It filters out nothing.

caption:
How someone treats you when it costs them nothing tells you little. Watch what happens when it actually costs them something.

Follow for one of these a day.
